facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Up to US$1M AWS Promotional Credits for accepted program companies + technical/GTM support
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Credits available to accepted cohort; subject to AWS promotional credit terms
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 0% program equity stated; no cash investment
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Generative/agentic AI startup; strong founding team, clear use case/market, product maturity, traction, AI technical depth. Current public program page describes invite-only priority-startup selection.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 8 weeks: in-person kickoff and closing weeks, 6 virtual weeks in between.
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Status: Current public page describes 2025 cohort; 2026 global intake not currently published
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Verification: Official page / current program status not open
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: keep as verified program model, but do NOT show as currently open until AWS publishes a new global cohort.
